title: Fuel Temperature Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance
shortDescription: PCM detected: fuel temperature sensor a circuit range/performance fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates fuel temperature sensor a circuit range/performance fault. The PCM monitors related signals against learned thresholds and stores the code when the fault matures.

Ignoring it can lead to driveability issues, increased emissions, or progressive component damage.

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect fuel temperature sensor a circuit range/performance fault wiring, connectors and related components for damage.

fixSteps.title: Electrical test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector with engine running.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect component and clear codes.

faq.a: Yes if engine runs normally; otherwise flatbed.
No - sensor or component replacement is typically required.
